QuestInfo.name: Kyrin's Teaching
QuestInfo.0: Since I still have yet to master Monster Mount and Spirit of the Craftsman, #bKyrin#k volunteered to teach me these skills...
QuestInfo.1: I'll have to go talk to #bKyrin#k about these skills...right?
QuestInfo.2: I was able to learn #rMonster Mount#k and #rSpirit of the Craftsman#k through Kyrin. Time to use them!

0.0: Ah, it's been a long time. I contacted you because I heard that you have already reached Lv. 120.
0.1: You haven't learned the #rMonster Rider#k and the #rLegendary Spirit#k skills yet. Would you like to learn them? It'll be my present to you in celebration of your reaching Lv. 120.

yes.0: Sure thing! An offer like this doesn't come often, so it's smart to take me up on it.

no.0: Hm, it's a rare opportunity. Are you going to just let this opportunity go to waste?

1.0: There, I've taught you the #rMonster Riding#k and the #rLegendary Spirit#k skills. I encourage you to check and make sure you've fully learned the skills.

yes.0: In order for you to mount on a monster, you need a #rsaddle#k and a #rhog#k, but I can't give them to you because you're too far. Would you like to come and get them from me?
yes.1: I'm in #b#m120000000##k in Victoria Island, so come here and get the things you need.
